A '''subrepeating blaster''' was a pistol-sized [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]] with a built-in folding [[Stock/Legends|stock]]. They were popular with space [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who wanted a small, easy-to-wield weapon with a lot of firepower. The subrepeating blaster was restricted to operating in autofire-only mode, that is, rapid automatic fire.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

[[Narp Pilyev]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]], hired two [[Security guard/Legends|security guards]] after he stole some valuable [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] documents and attempted to sell them to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Draba]]. These guards were armed with subrepeating blasters.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
